additionalProperty.value: Main route: need-based net of margin; up to ₹1 lakh for tractor repair/renovation and up to ₹2 lakh for a second-hand tractor. The separate new-tractor route without land mortgage is need-based; no fixed rupee ceiling is stated.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: Main route: tractor 7–9 years; second-hand tractor 5 years; power tiller 7 years; repairs/renovation 5 years; other machinery 7 years for small/marginal farmers and 5 years for other farmers. Instalments are half-yearly or yearly and linked to crop harvest/marketing; gestation is up to one year for small/marginal farmers and six months for others. Separate no-land-mortgage tractor route: up to 5 years in monthly, quarterly or half-yearly instalments; Circle Heads may extend 60 months to 72 months on merits. No moratorium is prescribed for this route.

item.name: PNB Financing to Farmer Producer Companies and Organisations

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Term loan and/or working capital; the sheet also says KCC repayment follows extant bank guidelines.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: The PDF sets out two routes. FPC guarantee coverage up to ₹1 crore requires: registration as an FPC under the named Companies Act provision; member equity; at least 500 individual shareholders; at least 33% small, marginal or landless tenant-farmer shareholders; no individual non-institutional member holding above 5% of equity; an elected/nominated board of at least five with farmer representation and one woman; a management committee; and an 18-month business plan and budget. The second route is for FPOs registered under any statute; the PDF gives no additional criteria in that section.

additionalProperty.name: Maximum amount
additionalProperty.value: Need-based. The PDF does not state an overall numeric loan ceiling. It says FPC loans up to ₹1 crore may qualify for the specified collateral-free credit-guarantee coverage; this is not stated as the scheme's maximum facility amount.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: Term-loan repayment follows bank guidelines based on purpose and income generation. Working capital runs for 12 months subject to annual renewal/review. Loans against NWR or for member-produce procurement are cleared within 12 months or sale of produce, whichever is earlier. KCC follows extant bank guidelines.

item.name: PNB Vehicle Loan for Farmers / Agriculturists

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Need-based vehicle loan for new two-wheelers, three-wheelers (carriers) and four-wheelers/LMVs.

additionalProperty.name: Minimum income
additionalProperty.value: At least ₹2.50 lakh gross annual income applies only to dairy, poultry, plantation, horticulture or other allied-activity applicants seeking a 3/4-wheeler under the landholding exemption; it is not a universal scheme threshold.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: New or existing farmers engaged in agriculture/allied activities with branch-assessed repayment capacity. Two-wheelers require direct agriculture/allied engagement. Three/four-wheelers normally require more than 1 acre of land in the applicant's name and 2 years of satisfactory bank dealings. For dairy, poultry, plantation, horticulture and other allied activities, the land threshold is waived if gross annual income is at least ₹2.50 lakh for a 3/4-wheeler. A branch may consider 1 acre where farm-produce transport use and economic viability are established.

additionalProperty.name: Maximum amount
additionalProperty.value: Two-wheeler: up to ₹1 lakh; three-wheeler carrier: up to ₹3 lakh; four-wheeler LMV: up to ₹15 lakh. Each limit is need-based and subject to repayment capacity.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: Two-/three-wheeler: up to 60 months. New four-wheeler: up to 84 months.

item.name: PNB Farmers' Trucks and Other Transport Vehicle Loan

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Need-based vehicle finance for agricultural transport; the sheet does not name one facility structure.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: Individual, Hindu Undivided Family or association of persons engaged in farming/allied activities; companies and cooperative societies are excluded. Minimum landholding is 3 acres for a truck, 2 acres for a light/medium vehicle such as jeep, pickup van or mini-truck, and 1 acre for a two-wheeler.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: Normally 60 months; Circle Heads may extend up to 72 months. Two-wheeler finance: maximum 5 years in 10 half-yearly instalments.

item.name: PNB Scheme for Financing Fisheries Development

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Need-based agriculture investment and working-capital facilities for inland/brackish-water and marine fisheries projects; the sheet does not name a single fixed facility structure.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: Inland/brackish-water applicants may be individual farmers, groups, cooperatives, companies or associations of persons with adequate know-how, experience/training and infrastructure; they must own the pond/land or hold a lease through project completion and have fishing rights for lake/reservoir projects. A water-quality report must accompany the application. Marine applicants may be technically qualified, experienced individuals, partnership firms or limited companies; deep-sea vessels require government permission to operate in the maritime zone.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: Pond fish culture: 5–8 years including 12 months' gestation, yearly repayment. Brackish-water fish/prawn culture: 5–10 years including 12 months' gestation, half-yearly repayment. FFDA-sponsored pond culture: 9 years with a 2-year repayment holiday. Non-mechanized boats/vessels: 6–7 years with 4 months' grace each year. Mechanized boats: 8–12 years with 4 months' grace each year.

additionalProperty.name: Prepayment / foreclosure
additionalProperty.value: PNB's current schedule lists 2% of the amount prepaid for a non-individual borrower taking over a term loan to move to another bank/FI, and 2% of the sanctioned limit for a non-individual borrower closing CC/OD before due date to shift lenders. It also lists a CC/OD no-charge condition with written non-renewal notice 3 months before due date and multiple borrower/facility-specific exemptions; this is not a blanket fisheries-loan charge.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: Farmers, SHGs, JLGs, companies and State undertakings with ownership, leasehold or perpetual-tenancy rights over the land; the proposed forestry plantation land must be marginally degraded or wasteland.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: Tree-growing forestry loans: up to 15 years including a grace period of up to 6 years. Short-term nursery loans: as per KCC Scheme; no separate period is stated.

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Need-based term finance for greenhouse projects; the sheet also permits short-term production credit under the KCC scheme.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: Applicant should own the required agricultural land; the site should be market-connected and have good-quality water, electricity and drainage. PNB may finance progressive farmers already using modern agricultural technology who have greenhouse experience/training, or existing greenhouse farmers expanding their units.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: Term loan: 5–7 years depending on loan amount, purpose and applicant request. Short-term production credit: 12 or 18 months under the KCC scheme.

additionalProperty.name: Prepayment / foreclosure
additionalProperty.value: PNB's current schedule lists 2% of the amount prepaid for a non-individual borrower taking over a term loan to move to another bank/FI, and 2% of the sanctioned limit for a non-individual borrower closing CC/OD before due date to shift lenders. It also lists a CC/OD no-charge condition with written non-renewal notice 3 months before due date and multiple borrower/facility-specific exemptions; this is not a blanket greenhouse-loan charge.

item.name: PNB Guruji Student Credit Card Scheme

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Education term loan under the Government of Jharkhand’s Guruji Student Credit Card Scheme; despite its name, it is not a revolving consumer credit card.

additionalProperty.name: Rate
additionalProperty.value: 3% p.a. simple interest if the student pays interest during study; otherwise 4% p.a. simple interest after State subsidy.

additionalProperty.name: Benchmark
additionalProperty.value: Floating SBI EBLR + 1.50 percentage points p.a. for male students and +1.00 percentage point p.a. for female students; simple interest. State subsidy reduces the student-payable rate to 3% or 4% as described separately.

additionalProperty.name: Minimum income
additionalProperty.value: No income ceiling for applying under the scheme.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: For eligible Jharkhand students admitted to a qualifying higher-education course/institution: age 40 or younger; local-residence certificate, or Class 10 in Jharkhand for diploma, or Class 10 plus Class 12/diploma from a Jharkhand school/college/university for degree; no previous scheme benefit. Close an ongoing same-course loan and obtain an NOC before applying. Parent/legal guardian co-applicant required. Institution-ranking conflict: Gazette amendment/FAQ say top 200 overall or top 100 in domain; one portal list section says top 100 overall.

additionalProperty.name: Maximum amount
additionalProperty.value: Up to ₹15 lakh

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: Up to 15 years, including the moratorium, counted from the first loan instalment disbursement.

additionalProperty.name: Processing fee
additionalProperty.value: No processing fee for sanction or disbursement is stated in the official FAQ.

additionalProperty.name: Prepayment / foreclosure
additionalProperty.value: No prepayment penalty or processing charge is stated in the official FAQ.

item.name: PNB Horticulture and Plantation Crops Finance

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Need-based horticulture/plantation finance; working-capital support follows the applicable scale of finance and marketing loans are a separate component.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: Individual farmers or groups need aptitude/adequate experience and the stipulated land, either owned or held as a long-term tenant/lessee with the lease extending at least 3 years beyond the project's economic life. Public-sector undertakings and private firms may seek project finance for fruit trees or other economic plants.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: 4–15 years, inclusive of the gestation period.

additionalProperty.name: Prepayment / foreclosure
additionalProperty.value: PNB's current schedule lists 2% of the amount prepaid for a non-individual borrower taking over a term loan to move to another bank/FI, and 2% of the sanctioned limit for a non-individual borrower closing CC/OD before due date to shift lenders. It also lists a CC/OD no-charge condition with written non-renewal notice 3 months before due date and multiple borrower/facility-specific exemptions; this is not a blanket horticulture-loan charge.

item.name: PNB Insta Loan against Securities (Mutual Fund)

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Advance against units of mutual funds.

additionalProperty.name: Benchmark
additionalProperty.value: RLLR 8.35% effective 8 October 2026; MCLR 8.10%–9.20% by tenor effective 1 November 2026. These are bank benchmarks, not this loan's all-in rate.

item.name: PNB Financing to Joint Liability Groups

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Model A finances individual members of the group; Model B finances the group itself. Both use the JLG mutual-undertaking mechanism.

additionalProperty.name: Rate
additionalProperty.value: Uses the interest rate applicable to the individual agriculture scheme under which the JLG finance is extended; PNB publishes no single JLG rate.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: Four to 10 individuals with similar socioeconomic background, generally in similar agriculture/allied activity, living in the same village/area/neighbourhood and able to take joint liability. A person who has previously defaulted to any formal financial institution cannot join; only one person from a family may belong to a given JLG.

additionalProperty.name: Maximum amount
additionalProperty.value: Need-based under both the individual-member and group-finance models.

additionalProperty.name: Prepayment / foreclosure
additionalProperty.value: For a non-individual borrower shifting a term loan to another bank/financial institution, PNB's current tariff lists 2% of the amount prepaid. For cash-credit/overdraft closure before its due date, it lists 2% of the sanctioned limit; that charge is waived if written non-renewal notice is given at least 3 months before the due date and the facility closes on that date. The tariff also lists exemptions, including eligible floating-rate loans to individuals/MSEs and loans prepaid from the borrower's own sources; this is not a universal early-repayment charge.

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Agriculture and allied-activity credit; the scheme sheet includes a cash-credit limit and working capital for allied activities, but does not define one facility type for every purpose.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: Existing good agricultural-land-owner borrowers must have continuously availed a loan and have no NPA record for the previous 2 years as of application. New farmers may qualify with at least 2 years of satisfactory dealings with another bank; PNB says that track-record condition may be relaxed for new farmers with good deposits over the previous 2 years. Multiple owners of mortgaged land may be eligible jointly or individually after declaring that there is no family dispute about title or the charge in PNB's favour.

additionalProperty.name: Maximum amount
additionalProperty.value: Up to ₹10 crore, further limited to the lower of 5 times the borrower's average annual total income over 2 years and 50% of the mortgaged-land value.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: Housing: 9 years including 12 months' gestation. Main agricultural activity: up to 9 years. Allied agriculture: up to 7 years. Working capital for allied activities: 12 months. For cash credit, aggregate credits over the previous 12 or 18 months should equal the outstanding; a drawal should not remain outstanding for more than 12 months, or 18 months for long-duration crops.

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Term loan

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: All farmers, including small and marginal farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers and agricultural labourers indebted to non-institutional money sources. A certificate from the moneylender discharging total liability is not required.

additionalProperty.name: Maximum amount
additionalProperty.value: ₹1,00,000 as a term loan; need-based credit up to the stated maximum.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: 5–7 years, including a maximum 12-month moratorium; half-yearly or yearly instalments.

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Two cash-credit components: crop-production KCC and Krishak Unnati credit for agricultural/allied development.

additionalProperty.name: Rate
additionalProperty.value: The KCC component follows PNB's KCC terms; the current rate table lists regular KCC outstanding up to ₹3 lakh at 7.00% p.a. No separate Krishak Unnati-component rate is named on the reviewed current rate page.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: Existing good agricultural land-owner borrowers who have borrowed continuously from PNB for two years and had no loan account classified NPA during the preceding two years. Other scheduled-commercial-bank customers may qualify after two years of satisfactory dealings if none of their loan accounts was NPA in the preceding two years; PNB obtains and reviews statements for all their loan accounts for the previous 12 months.

additionalProperty.name: Maximum amount
additionalProperty.value: Up to ₹10 lakh; the umbrella limit is the lowest of twice the KCC limit assessed for the proposed cropping pattern, 50% of the agricultural-land value used for calculation, or ₹10 lakh.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: Both components are valid for five years subject to annual review. The short-term cash-credit limit is reviewed annually to check that crop and other sale proceeds are routed through the account.

item.name: PNB Krishi Bhu-Swami Agri-Land Purchase Scheme

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Term loan

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: Small and marginal farmers, sharecroppers, tenant farmers and entrepreneurs with an agricultural background. After purchase, total holding must not exceed 2.5 irrigated acres or 5 non-irrigated acres (or equivalent). Land must be within 15 km of existing owned land or residence, or within the command area, whichever is higher.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: 7–12 years in half-yearly or yearly instalments, including a maximum 24-month moratorium.

item.name: PNB Personal Loan for LIC Employees

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Personal loan for all types of personal needs to confirmed/permanent LIC employees.

additionalProperty.name: Rate
additionalProperty.value: Salary credited through PNB: 8.85% p.a. floating / 9.35% fixed. Salary not credited through PNB: 8.85% floating / 9.85% fixed. The non-salary floating row adds 0.50 percentage points but prints the same floating rate as the salary route.

additionalProperty.name: Benchmark
additionalProperty.value: PNB salary-account route: RLLR+BSP. Other route: RLLR+BSP+0.50 percentage points. The latter row nevertheless prints the same presently applicable floating rate (8.85%) as the salary-account row; no correction is inferred.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: Confirmed/permanent LIC employees with at least 1 year of service. Nil security applies when more than ₹75,000 monthly salary is credited to the PNB account in each of the last 3 months; otherwise an acceptable third-party guarantee is required.

additionalProperty.name: Maximum amount
additionalProperty.value: Up to 24× gross monthly salary, capped at ₹20 lakh, subject to repayment capacity.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: Remaining period of service or maximum 72 EMIs, whichever is earlier.

additionalProperty.name: Processing fee
additionalProperty.value: Nil processing/upfront and nil documentation charges.

additionalProperty.name: Prepayment / foreclosure
additionalProperty.value: Nil.

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Collateral-free household microfinance loan.

additionalProperty.name: Rate
additionalProperty.value: Retail/personal: RLLR + BSP +5.00%; retail/other purpose: RLLR + BSP +3.25%; MSME food-processing (agriculture): RLLR + BSP +1.20%; MSME unit: RLLR + BSP +1.40%; agriculture: MCLR +2.70%. Current RLLR is 8.35% effective 8 October 2026; current MCLR tenors are effective 1 November 2026. The page does not state the microfinance BSP amount, a single all-in scheme rate, or an MCLR tenor for the agriculture row, so no all-in rate is calculated.

additionalProperty.name: Benchmark
additionalProperty.value: RLLR 8.35% effective 8 October 2026. MCLR effective 1 November 2026: overnight 8.10%, 1 month 8.35%, 3 months 8.60%, 6 months 8.75%, 1 year 8.90% and 3 years 9.20%. These are benchmark values, not the scheme's RLLR+BSP or MCLR+spread all-in rate.

additionalProperty.name: Minimum income
additionalProperty.value: PNB's scheme sheet requires actual or projected annual household income up to ₹3,00,000. The FPC defines a household as husband, wife and their unmarried children.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: Actual or projected annual household income up to ₹3,00,000. PNB defines a household as husband, wife and unmarried children. Total repayments on every existing household loan plus the proposed loan, including principal and interest, must be no more than 50% of monthly household income; no new loan is provided while the household is above this limit.

additionalProperty.name: Maximum amount
additionalProperty.value: Maximum ₹1,00,000.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: Maximum 36 equal monthly instalments. PNB permits monthly, quarterly or half-yearly repayment periodicity according to borrower requirements.

additionalProperty.name: Prepayment / foreclosure
additionalProperty.value: No prepayment penalty or foreclosure charge on a microfinance loan to a household borrower. PNB's tariff exception is for loans to NBFC-MFIs; it does not describe the household product in this scheme.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: Normally at least 1 acre of agricultural land; the rule does not apply to projects sponsored by DRDA, SGSY or a State Development Agency. Project must be in a white area, technically feasible and economically viable. Tubewells must be at least 200 square yards apart.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: Pumpsets 9 years; well deepening/Persian wheels/Rahat 5 years; watercourse/field channels 9–15 years; sprinkler/drip 10–15 years; listed wells, lift irrigation and CAD/OFD facilities 11–15 years. Gestation: pumpsets 12 months, OFD 24 months, lift irrigation 36 months, others up to 1 year.

item.name: PNB Mushroom Cultivation and Spawn Production Finance

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: The single scheme provides need-based cultivation finance and an integral spawn-production loan with investment and recurring/working-capital expenditure.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: Mushroom cultivation: individuals and larger units with adequate cultivation experience. Spawn production: individuals and larger units with plant-pathology qualification or an appropriate background and training in spawn production.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: Mushroom cultivation: maximum 7 years including 6 months' gestation. Spawn production: maximum 7 years including 1 year's gestation.

additionalProperty.name: Prepayment / foreclosure
additionalProperty.value: PNB's current schedule lists 2% of the amount prepaid for a non-individual borrower taking over a term loan to move to another bank/FI, and 2% of the sanctioned limit for a non-individual borrower closing CC/OD before due date to shift lenders. It also lists a CC/OD no-charge condition with written non-renewal notice 3 months before due date and multiple borrower/facility-specific exemptions; this is not a blanket mushroom-loan charge.

item.name: PNB Financing to SHGs under NRLM

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Cash-credit limit and term loan.

additionalProperty.name: Rate
additionalProperty.value: Up to ₹3 lakh: 7.00% p.a. Above ₹3 lakh to ₹5 lakh: lower of 8.90% MCLR or 10%, so the current arithmetic result is 8.90%. Above ₹5 lakh to ₹20 lakh, and NPA accounts irrespective of amount: 1-year MCLR +2.10% for repayment up to 1 year (11.00% calculated), +2.15% for over 1–3 years (11.05%), and +2.70% above 3 years (11.60%). Above ₹20 lakh: internal/external risk-rating based. Current 1-year MCLR is 8.90% effective 1 November 2026; calculated examples are not separate borrower-specific quotes.

additionalProperty.name: Benchmark
additionalProperty.value: Up to ₹3 lakh: 7.00% p.a.; above ₹3 lakh to ₹5 lakh: lower of 1-year MCLR or 10%; above ₹5 lakh to ₹20 lakh, and NPA accounts irrespective of amount, use 1-year MCLR plus the published tenure spread; above ₹20 lakh: risk-rating based. Current 1-year MCLR is 8.90% effective 1 November 2026.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: SHGs of 10–20 members; at least 5 in remote/difficult tribal areas or groups with disabled persons. The SHG must be active for at least 6 months per its books, follow regular meetings/savings/inter-lending/repayment/up-to-date records, and meet NABARD grading norms. A revived defunct SHG must remain active for at least 3 months.

additionalProperty.name: Maximum amount
additionalProperty.value: Cash credit: advised minimum ₹6 lakh for an eligible SHG for 3 years, with annual drawing-power review. Year 1: 6× corpus or ₹1.5 lakh, whichever is higher; year 2: 8× corpus or ₹3 lakh, whichever is higher; year 3: at least ₹6 lakh based on the micro-credit plan and history; year 4 onward: above ₹6 lakh based on the plan/history. Term-loan doses: first 6× corpus or ₹1.5 lakh, whichever is higher; second 8× corpus or ₹3 lakh, whichever is higher; third and fourth at least ₹6 lakh each, plan/history based. The sheet states no fixed maximum ceiling.

item.name: PNB Scheme on Organic Farming and Organic Inputs

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Cash credit in the form of a Kisan Credit Card and/or term loan.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: Individuals, SHGs and JLGs with sufficient land for crops or vegetables. Vacant land in or around a residential house may also be used when the applicant has the right to use it.

additionalProperty.name: Maximum amount
additionalProperty.value: Need-based; the scheme sheet gives no fixed numeric loan ceiling.

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Need-based piggery finance; the sheet distinguishes production credit from investment credit.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: Farmers, agricultural labourers and other entrepreneurs may establish units as a main or subsidiary activity. PNB says the State Animal Husbandry Department should be consulted about pig quality and unit size. The 1.5–2-year age condition applies to the pigs financed, not the applicant.

additionalProperty.name: Maximum amount
additionalProperty.value: Need-based at the unit cost approved by the State unit cost committee; the usual unit comprises 1 boar and 3 sows. Feed and medicine may be financed for no more than 9 months. No fixed rupee ceiling is stated.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure

additionalProperty.value: For a non-individual borrower taking over a loan to shift to another bank/FI, PNB's current schedule states 2% of the prepaid amount on term loans and 2% of the sanctioned limit when a cash-credit/overdraft facility is closed before its due date. For CC/OD, the stated charge does not apply if written non-renewal notice is given 3 months before the due date and the facility closes on that date. The page lists additional exemptions, including specified floating-rate individual/MSE loans, MSE borrowers, own-source repayment and other stated cases. Exact applicability depends on borrower, purpose, facility, rate type and closure route.

item.name: PNB PM KUSUM Scheme — Solar Energy

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Term loan; the sheet's listed common documents include a facility agreement for term loan and term-loan agreement.

additionalProperty.name: Rate
additionalProperty.value: Three-month MCLR plus rating spread: A1–A3, 8.60% p.a.; A4–B1, 8.85%; B2, 10.10%; B3 and below, 11.10%. Small and marginal farmers rated up to B1: 8.60%. These are calculated examples using PNB's 8.60% three-month MCLR effective 1 November 2026; the scheme sheet's embedded 8.40% note is stale, and final pricing follows the published benchmark formula and rating.

additionalProperty.name: Benchmark
additionalProperty.value: PNB three-month MCLR: 8.60% effective 1 November 2026; the four-component PM-KUSUM schedule links its published rating spreads to this benchmark.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: Component A: farmers individually or with farmer groups, cooperatives, panchayats, FPOs or WUAs may set up 500 kW–2 MW projects; developer or DISCOM arrangements are allowed in specified cases. Component B: individual farmers with off-grid standalone solar agriculture pumps up to 7.5 HP. Component C (IPS): individual farmers with grid-connected agriculture pumps; solar PV may be up to twice pump capacity. Component C (FLS/C2): State/feeder-level solarisation implemented through State agencies or DISCOMs. These are MNRE scheme rules, not PNB credit-approval criteria.

additionalProperty.name: Maximum amount
additionalProperty.value: Component A: maximum ₹10 crore. Components B, C (IPS) and C2 (FLS): need-based; the PNB sheet gives no numeric ceiling for these three components.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure
additionalProperty.value: Component A: 15 years. Component B: 10 years. Component C (IPS): 10 years. Component C2 (FLS): 15 years.

additionalProperty.name: Prepayment / foreclosure
additionalProperty.value: PNB's tariff section 10.15: when a non-individual borrower shifts a term loan to another bank/FI, 2% of the prepaid amount; for cash-credit/overdraft closed before its due date, 2% of the sanctioned limit. No cash-credit/overdraft closure fee if the borrower gives written non-renewal notice 3 months before the due date and closes on that date. The same section exempts floating-rate loans to individuals for non-business purposes and to individuals/MSEs for business purposes, with or without co-obligants, with no lock-in; further listed exceptions include MSE borrowers, borrower-owned funds and specified rate-reset/term-change cases. Applicability depends on borrower/facility type and the exact sanction terms.

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Working-capital term loan for street vendors.

additionalProperty.name: Rate
additionalProperty.value: PNB's PM SVANidhi page, last updated 17 January 2026, quotes a starting rate of 10.25% p.a. linked to RLLR. PNB's RLLR is now 8.35% effective 8 October 2026, but the scheme page does not publish a spread; 10.25% is retained as the last published quote, not recalculated or confirmed as repriced.

additionalProperty.name: Benchmark
additionalProperty.value: RLLR 8.35% effective 8 October 2026. PNB's PM SVANidhi page does not state a product-specific spread.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility

Government FAQ defines a vendor as a person selling goods or offering services to the public from a street, footpath, pavement or similar temporary/mobile location. A valid LoR or CoV is an application route; timely/early repayment qualifies for the next enhanced tranche.

additionalProperty.name: Maximum amount
additionalProperty.value: 1st tranche: up to ₹15,000; 2nd tranche: up to ₹25,000; 3rd tranche: up to ₹50,000.

additionalProperty.name: Tenure

additionalProperty.name: Processing fee
additionalProperty.value: No processing fee or documentation charge on PNB's published PM SVANidhi page.

additionalProperty.name: Loan type
additionalProperty.value: Home finance for eligible urban families to purchase, re-purchase or construct a house under PMAY-U 2.0; applicable to loans sanctioned and disbursed on or after 1 September 2024.

additionalProperty.name: Eligibility
additionalProperty.value: EWS: up to ₹3 lakh; LIG: above ₹3 lakh to ₹6 lakh; MIG: above ₹6 lakh to ₹9 lakh per year. States/UTs may revise the EWS ceiling with Ministry concurrence.

additionalProperty.name: Maximum amount

additionalProperty.name: Rate

additionalProperty.name: Benchmark

item.name: PNB Housing Finance Scheme for NRIs and OCIs
